raw_blocks: We put your freight first
XPO is a leading LTL carrier
Our extensive network covers 99% of all US zip codes through a single source, plus Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean.
Our proprietary software gives customers easy-to-use tools that streamline their experience. We use data science and machine learning to optimize for efficiency.
We’re adding new terminals and expanding existing sites. We also build our own trailers in-house, and train new drivers at our 130 XPO driver school locations so we can quickly add capacity.
With over three decades in the LTL business, and 18 billion pounds of freight moved last year, we know exactly what it takes to deliver results for our 37,000 customers.
Creating new ways to put your freight first
We’re always expanding our network, capacity and technology, so we can serve every customer with excellence.
We’re one of the largest LTL carriers in North America, and we’re investing in more growth: adding equipment and doors, and training drivers to expand our team.
Our job is to help you succeed. We understand your business needs and treat your freight like it’s our own.
We’re always working on the next great idea to deliver value for customers with our LTL network technology, web tools and EDI/API integrations.
We communicate constantly with customers to make sure you’re getting the excellent service you deserve.
Our leaders are at the top of their fields, with expertise across operations and technology. We prioritize safety, a customer-centric culture and operational excellence.
We've created an LTL network equipped with national capacity, leading technology and a world-class team. And we're always building and improving.
We constantly work to improve the safety and well-being of our people. That means staying up-to-date on the latest protocols, technologies and equipment so we can continue to do what we do best.

We take pride in doing things the right way, which means speaking up when we see opportunities to improve and owning mistakes. By prioritizing accountability, integrity and a job well done, we make sure team members can count on each other, and our customers know they can count on us to do right by them.

We’re forward-thinking and always investing in our people, technology and network to deliver better results every day. Innovation runs deep in our veins, as we find new ways to improve our performance for customers, employees and shareholders.
We work hard to ensure our people feel respected and empowered. We build a collaborative culture that emphasizes respect, honesty and making sure every teammate has a voice.
Be world-class in every way
We’re eager to be #1 in LTL. We’re competitive and driven to win, which means we don’t settle for anything less than the best for ourselves, our customers and our shareholders.
We turn values into action
We stay focused on safety through training, technology and the oversight of safety leaders stationed throughout our network.
We not only embrace inclusion, we make sure our teams reflect the diverse communities we serve. Diverse backgrounds and ways of thinking are key to how we innovate and succeed.
Operational efficiency is good for the environment and for our business. We invest in fuel management, LED lighting, electronic reduction of paper waste and pilot programs for electric vehicles.
Recognized as an industry leader
Named to the FreightTech 100 by FreightWaves (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022)
Named one of America’s Most Responsible Companies by Newsweek (2024, 2023, 2022)
Named one of America’s Best Large Employers by Forbes (2023, 2022)
Named a Top Company for Women to Work for in Transportation by Women in Trucking Association (2024, 2023, 2022, 2021)
Named a Top 25 Veteran Employer by Military.com (2024)
Named one of America’s Most Innovative Companies by Fortune (2025)
Named one of America’s Most Reliable Companies by Newsweek (2025)
Named Less-Than-Truckload Carrier of the Year by Total Quality Logistics (2024)
Named National Less-Than-Truckload Carrier of the Year by MODE Global (2023, 2022)
Named LTL Carrier Partner of the Year by GlobalTranz (2023, 2022, 2021)
Named Top 100 Trucker by Inbound Logistics (2023, 2022, 2021)
Every employee – from drivers, to dockworkers, to technologists – is critical to our success. Let’s connect!
Be part of our success. Invest in us.

LTL is an industry with substantial barriers to entry, durable end markets, secular tailwinds and strong pricing dynamics. XPO is one of the leading LTL carriers for the investor audience, with a strong track record of outsized value creation for shareholders.

pages.raw_title: World-Class LTL Freight Transportation Services - XPO
pages.raw_meta: XPO offers world-class services to fulfill LTL shipping requirements. Learn more about XPO’s on-time and damage-free deliveries.
raw_blocks: Services to strengthen your supply chain performance
We put your freight first
Our coast-to-coast network is designed to deliver your freight on-time and damage-free. Our best-in-class services help you manage transportation needs with maximum efficiency.
One network, one team delivering national coverage
We run one of the largest LTL networks in North America.
Our network covers 99% of US zip codes. We offer efficient cross-border and offshore service to Canada, Mexico, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.
With 9,700 tractors, 34,400 trailers and more than 13,000 professional drivers, we manage volume for customers of every size. And we’re adding to our fleet, so we can scale as customers grow.
Share your shipping challenges, and we’ll deliver the right solutions.

Simplify your Must Arrive by Date (MABD) shipments with XPO. Choose from two service options tailored to meet retailer delivery windows. Gain peace of mind with priority handling, dedicated care, simple flat-rate pricing, 24/7 tracking visibility, and more.
Choose XPO’s Trade Show Service and experience worry-free pickup and delivery service when shipping your trade show booth and exhibit materials.

Get unparalleled support and priority service for your product rollouts. Give us your rollout distributions and we’ll create a program tailored to your unique needs. Our customized solutions will unlock the full potential of your brand!
Shipping to and from Mexico
Get a safe, secure cross border shipping solution with a hassle-free customs clearance process, a single invoice and assistance from our knowledgeable Mexico support team.

Whether it’s to protect your LTL freight that can’t be commingled or handled during shipping, or to increase security on your delicate, fragile, and high-value freight, our Exclusive Use Service gives you a private trailer and instant capacity so you can rest easy.

Our Guaranteed Services help you avoid costly shutdowns and missed deadlines. Shipments receive enhanced visibility throughout transit in the network. Choose from day-definite Guaranteed Service or Guaranteed by Noon Service for your priority shipments.
As a preferred carrier for leading grocers in the US and Canada, we provide upfront, all-in-one pricing, door-to-door visibility and the expertise required to avoid claims and added charges.

Simplify LTL pickups for inbound shipments and returns with our Coordinated Pickup Service. We manage scheduling, paperwork, monitoring and issue resolution, helping you reduce complexity and keep freight moving on schedule.
With no appointment or signature required, XPO's service streamlines deliveries to private residences, condos, apartments, farms, or businesses located at a residence.

We have thousands of service pros laser-focused on delivering operational excellence and providing world-class customer service. We make sure we know our customers' businesses and needs, and we ensure on-time pickup and delivery, damage-free delivery and accurate invoicing.
Our web tools give you control over your shipping, providing real-time visibility and detailed analytics.
Custom rate quotes based on your pricing agreement
Manifest and shipment summary reports
